title: Deposit Insurance and Policy Owners' Protection Schemes (Amendment) Bill
what_it_is: Deposit Insurance and Policy Owners' Protection Schemes (Amendment) Bill

sections.label: Higher deposit insurance coverage limit
sections.summary: The Scheme's maximum coverage level will be raised from S$50,000 to S$75,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: First, the maximum level of coverage under the Scheme will be increased from S$50,000 to S$75,000.

sections.label: Fully insured depositors percentage
sections.summary: Raising the limit to S$75,000 restores fully insured depositors to above 90%, so the DI Scheme keeps serving its objective.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Increasing the limit to S$75,000 will restore the percentage of fully insured depositors to above 90%, ensuring that the DI Scheme continues to serve its objective.

sections.label: Higher contributions and longer build-up
sections.summary: The Bill raises member contributions by up to one basis point and extends the fund build-up period from 2020 to 2028.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The Bill will raise the contribution by up to one basis point per Scheme member, to support the higher coverage limit of S$75,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: At the same time, we will extend the fund build-up period from 2020 to 2028.

sections.label: Removal of reasonable care requirement
sections.summary: The Bill proposes removing the "reasonable care" requirement, which may distract SDIC and undermine its effectiveness.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The Bill proposes to remove this requirement of “reasonable care”, which may present a distraction to SDIC and undermine its effectiveness.

sections.label: Indemnification for SDIC officers
sections.summary: The amended Act provides indemnification for reasonable legal costs of SDIC officers acting in good faith, aligned with Core Principles recommendations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The amended Act will also provide indemnification for reasonable legal costs and expenses incurred by SDIC officers in connection with actions or omissions in good faith.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: These amendments are aligned with the recommendations in the Core Principles for Effective DI Systems, developed by the International Association of Deposit Insurers, and will provide greater assurance to SDIC and its officers in performing their duty to make compensation payments promptly, while maintaining accountability by retaining the requirement for the officers to act in good faith.

sections.label: Three-year block estimates for SDIC
sections.summary: The amended Act lets SDIC submit three-year block estimates, enabling longer-term planning to enhance its operations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The amended Act will allow SDIC to submit three-year block estimates instead.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: This will enable SDIC to make longer-term plans to enhance its operations.

sections.label: Registrar and life insurance policies
sections.summary: Insurance companies must submit life policy details to the Registrar, who notifies them of a policy holder's death and helps contact next of kin or beneficiary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: All insurance companies offering life insurance policies must submit the policy details to the Registrar.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: When the Registrar becomes aware of the death of a policy holder, the insurance companies will be notified.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: The Registrar will also assist to contact the next of kin or beneficiary to inform them of the existence of the policy.

sections.label: Bill aims and DI coverage
sections.summary: The Bill clarifies technical issues, enhances operational efficiency of two SDIC schemes, and raises DI coverage from $50,000 to $75,000, achieving 91% coverage of fully insured depositors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The aim of this Bill is largely to clarify technical issues and enhance the operational efficiency of the two schemes administered by SDIC.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: It also raises the DI coverage from $50,000 to $75,000 which would achieve 91% coverage of fully insured depositors.

sections.label: Higher DI coverage limit
sections.summary: Raising the DI coverage limit from $50,000 to $75,000 per depositor per Scheme member is good news for all Singaporean depositors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Increasing the DI coverage limit from $50,000 to $75,000 per depositor per Scheme member is good news for all Singaporean depositors.

sections.label: MAS raising bank premium rates
sections.summary: Following the DI coverage increase, MAS will raise the premium rates charged to banks, so depositors are not lulled into complacency.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: This way, they will not be lulled into a sense of complacency and, in a crunch, find themselves put in a dilemma.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: But following the increase of the DI coverage, MAS will also raise the premium rates which are charged to banks.

sections.label: Policy Owners' Protection Scheme expansion
sections.summary: Extending the Policy Owners' Protection Scheme to such properties assures freelancers of protection, and expanded legal protection and voluntary winding up shorten waiting time for compensation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: By extending the coverage of the Policy Owners' Protection Scheme to such properties, these freelancers can have assurance that they are adequately protected against life’s uncertainties.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: And, once again, I will ask: will this result in a rise in premiums?

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: And with the expansion of the legal protection for SDIC officers to perform their role in making prompt compensation payments, along with voluntary winding up as a new trigger for compensation payouts, consumers protected under these schemes will experience a shorter waiting time for their money.

sections.label: Premium increase for local banks
sections.summary: The one basis point premium increase for banks is not material relative to overall operating costs, costing the three local banks less than 0.1% on average.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The premium increase of one basis point to the banks as Scheme Members is not material relative to a bank's overall operating costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: To illustrate, the increases in costs for the three local banks, which are the largest Scheme Members, will be less than 0.1% of their operating costs on average.

sections.label: SDIC payout timeline
sections.summary: SDIC aims to pay most insured depositors within seven working days, in line with international standards, with mechanisms and procedures in place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: SDIC aims to make payouts to most insured depositors within seven working days, in line with international standards and has relevant mechanisms and procedures in place to facilitate this.

sections.label: Deposit Insurance Fund investment rules
sections.summary: The DI-PPF Act limits the Fund to safe assets like Government or MAS securities and MAS deposits, for capital preservation and liquidity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The management of the Fund is circumscribed by the DI-PPF Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: And under the Act, the Fund may only be invested in safe assets, such as securities issued by the Government or MAS, deposits with MAS or such other investments, with the objects of capital preservation and maintenance of liquidity.
